task.title: Connect to NC State's VPN
task.shortdesc: Your step-by-step guide for connecting to the NC State VPN, including authentication through Duo multifactor authentication.

prereq.p: Before connecting to the NC State VPN, make sure you have:

ul.li: Installed Cisco Secure Client on your computer or mobile device.
Enrolled in Duo two-factor authentication (2FA) with your NC State Unity ID.

step.cmd: Open the Cisco Secure Client application on your device.
Type vpn.ncsu.edu in the server address box and select Connect.
From the Group drop-down menu, select the appropriate VPN group for your needs and affiliation at NC State.
Enter your NC State Unity ID in the Username field and your Unity password in the Password field.
In the Second Password field, enter your Duo authentication choice:

ul.li: Type push (or leave the field blank, as Duo Push is the default) to receive a push notification in the Duo Mobile app.
Enter a 6-digit passcode generated in the Duo Mobile app.
Enter a 9-digit passcode from the self-service Duo passcode tool or an OIT Help Desk bypass code.

step.cmd: Select OK, approve the Duo prompt if using Duo Push, and wait for Cisco Secure Client to connect to the NC State network.

result.p: Your device is connected to the NC State VPN. Keep the Cisco Secure Client window open in the background to maintain your VPN connection, and select Disconnect when you are finished.
